sentences.content: Are you free this weekend? Let’s play ping-pong.
sentences.english: Are you free this weekend ? Let's play ping-pong
sentences.chinese: 这个周末你有空吗？我们一起去打乒乓球吧。

sentences.content: I often go swimming on Saturdays.
sentences.english: I often go swimming on Saturdays
sentences.chinese: 我经常在星期六去游泳。

sentences.content: We can go on a picnic in spring.
sentences.english: We can go on a picnic in spring
sentences.chinese: 我们可以在春天去野餐。

sentences.content: My father is a doctor. He often works at night.
sentences.english: My father is a doctor . He often works at night
sentences.chinese: 我的父亲是位医生，他经常在夜间工作。

wordDetails.definition: work（第三人称单数）: 工作

sentences.content: When do you go to bed? I go to bed at 10 p.m.
sentences.english: When do you go to bed ? I go to bed at 10 p . m
sentences.chinese: 你什么时候睡觉？我晚上10点睡觉。

sentences.content: It is autumn in April in Sydney. It is warm in the day and cool at night.
sentences.english: It is autumn in April in Sydney . It is warm in the day and cool at night
sentences.chinese: 悉尼的四月正值秋季。白天温暖，夜晚凉爽。

sentences.content: You can visit the Sydney Opera House. It’s the most famous building in Australia.
sentences.english: You can visit the Sydney Opera House . It's the most famous building in Australia
sentences.chinese: 您可以参观悉尼歌剧院，这是澳大利亚最著名的建筑。

sentences.content: In winter I get up at night and dress by yellow candlelight.
sentences.english: In winter I get up at night and dress by yellow candlelight
sentences.chinese: 冬日里，我于夜半起身，借着昏黄的烛光穿衣。

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 起床

sentences.content: In summer, I have to go to bed by day.
sentences.english: In summer , I have to go to bed by day
sentences.chinese: 夏天时，我不得不在白天就上床睡觉。

sentences.content: The birds are still hopping on the tree, and I want to play.
sentences.english: The birds are still hopping on the tree , and I want to play
sentences.chinese: 鸟儿仍在树上跳跃，而我想去玩耍。
